name: Authentik (SSO + MFA)
summary: Self-hosted SSO IdP with MFA and a policy engine.
description: Authentik is an open-source Identity Provider that centralises authentication across all your apps. This one-click template deploys the full Authentik stack: server (API + UI + SSO flows), worker (background tasks) and a managed PostgreSQL database, pre-wired over Railway private networking with an auto-generated secret key. No manual environment variables required.

services.name: Postgres
services.note: Keep the service name exactly 'Postgres' so the ${{Postgres.*}} references below resolve.

deploy.note: Healthcheck added to the published template on 2026-08-12. Returns 200 only once the database connection is up, so Railway waits through first-boot migrations.

volumeMounts.note: Persistent volume for uploaded media (icons, logos, user avatars). Without it, media is lost on redeploy.

publicNetworking.note: Railway generates an HTTPS domain and injects PORT for routing.

resources.note: Authentik's server needs ~300-500MB idle plus headroom. 1GB is the recommended default.

variables.description: Tells Railway which port to route. Authentik listens on 9000 by default.
Random 64-char hex secret (32 bytes), generated once per template deployment. The worker references this value.
PostgreSQL host via Railway private network.
PostgreSQL port via Railway private network.
Gunicorn worker processes. Lowered to 1 to fit small instances; raise if the instance is busy.
Keep error reporting off for a clean, minimal deployment. Optional.

publicNetworking.note: No public access. The worker only talks to Postgres over the private network.

resources.note: The Rust worker entrypoint in 2026.5 uses ~300MB less memory than older versions.

variables.description: Must be identical to the server's secret key. References the value generated on 'Authentik Server'. Never use a separate ${{secret(...)}} here.
PostgreSQL host via Railway private network.
PostgreSQL port via Railway private network.
Disable the 'check for updates' feature (avoids outbound calls to goauthentik.io). Optional.
Keep error reporting off for a clean, minimal deployment. Optional.

breakdown.authentik-server: ~0-10 (1GB RAM, sleeps when idle on Railway's serverless model; bills only while awake)
breakdown.authentik-worker: ~0-6 (512MB RAM, sleeps when idle; bills only while awake)

estimatedCostPerMonthUSD.note: Both apps run with app sleeping enabled (Railway default), so idle-heavy usage fits the $5 Hobby monthly credit; active usage approaches $10-20. New accounts start with a one-time $5 trial credit. See README for current Railway pricing.

notes: Snapshot of the published composer config: service names are 'Authentik Server' and 'Authentik Worker'; AUTHENTIK_SECRET_KEY is generated on the server with ${{secret(64, ...)}} and referenced from the worker with ${{'Authentik Server'.AUTHENTIK_SECRET_KEY}}.
Healthcheck /-/health/ready/ (timeout 600s) and persistent volume at /data (min 1 GB) added to 'Authentik Server' in the published template on 2026-08-12 (verified via template serializedConfig).
No Redis: authentik 2026.5+ dropped Redis. The task queue (Dramatiq) and cache run on PostgreSQL, matching upstream's official docker-compose.
Admin setup happens through the out-of-the-box wizard at /if/flow/initial-setup/ on first boot. No bootstrap variables are pre-set on purpose: the user picks their own akadmin password.
Pin policy: the image tag is fixed to a specific release. Never use :latest in a published template.
The initial-setup flow and /if/admin/ login page are served by authentik on PORT=9000 over Railway's HTTPS public domain.
